title: BacFun-eRNA: functional metatranscriptomics workflow for microbial communities
description:
BacFun-eRNA is a modular Bash workflow for functional metatranscriptomic analysis of environmental or host-associated microbial communities. It performs quality control (FastQC, MultiQC), adapter trimming (fastp), rRNA removal (SortMeRNA), taxonomic profiling (MetaPhlAn) and functional profiling of genes and pathways (HUMAnN3), regrouping to KEGG, EggNOG, Pfam, EC and GO, normalisation and stratification of abundance tables, and KEGG pathway enrichment with DESeq2-based differential abundance in R.

Developed in the Marine Biology Research Group, Ghent University.
